title: STOP bleeding from wounds inflicted by people just looking for clout. 🛑🗣️
paragraphs: STOP bleeding from wounds inflicted by people just looking for clout. 🛑🗣️
If someone genuinely wants to see you grow, they will offer correction with grace in private. They value your relationship more than the performance of being "right."
But if they bypass your DM and go straight to the public comment section, the group chat, or the stage... realize this: It is no longer about you. It is about the audience.
They aren't trying to build you up; they are trying to build a stage for themselves by standing on your neck. It’s not righteous indignation; it’s theater for their own ego.
Do not internalize performance art. See it for the desperate need for attention that it is, and keep walking. Your peace is too expensive to spend on cheap critics.

📖 The Biblical blueprint for real conflict resolution: "If your brother or sister sins, go and point out their fault, just between the two of you. If they listen to you, you have won them over." — Matthew 18:15 (NIV)
